name: Google for Startups Cloud Program (AI Scale Tier)
requirements: Corporate domain website, Google Cloud Organization + Billing Account, partner/accelerator or VC backing (Start Tier up to $2k–$20k requires no VC).
tip: Pair with NVIDIA Inception membership to unlock the AI Scale tier ($200k Year 1 + $150k Year 2 covering Vertex AI, Gemini, Claude Partner Models, and GKE).

name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
requirements: LinkedIn profile, live product or prototype URL, B2B/B2C software product roadmap (no funding required for initial $1k–$25k tiers).
tip: Start at Stage 1 ($1,000–$5,000) pre-incorporation with just a LinkedIn check, then submit incorporation docs + pitch video to unlock $25k–$150k Azure OpenAI & GPU credits.

name: Cloudflare for Startups (Enterprise + Workers AI)
requirements: Domain active on Cloudflare DNS/Pages, software-based product, <$50M raised.
tip: Covers Workers AI serverless GPU inference, R2 zero-egress object storage, D1 SQLite, Vectorize, and Enterprise Zero-Trust WAF across 3 domains.

name: AWS Activate (Founders & Portfolio)
requirements: AWS account, company website, and either self-funded status ($1k Founders tier) or an Activate Provider Organization ID ($10k–$100k Portfolio tier).
tip: Credits apply to Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama, Nova), EC2 GPU instances (P5/G6), S3, and RDS. Join NVIDIA Inception or Stripe Atlas to get a Portfolio Org ID.

name: NVIDIA Inception Program for AI Startups
requirements: AI/ML core technology, live website, corporate email, English pitch deck PDF (<10 Years old).
tip: Free membership with zero equity. Acts as the #1 partner multiplier to unlock higher tiers in Google Cloud ($350k), AWS Activate ($25k–$100k), and preferred GPU pricing.

name: DigitalOcean Hatch Startup Program
requirements: Company website, corporate email, and accelerator/VC or partner affiliation (self-serve tiers start at $1,000–$10,000).
tip: Valid for GPU Droplets (H100/MI300X), Managed Kubernetes (DOKS), Managed Databases, and Spaces CDN.

name: OVHcloud Startup Program (Showcase & Scale)
requirements: Innovative software/AI startup, live site, no VC required for €10,000 Start tier.
tip: Includes dedicated engineering solution architect hours and sovereign EU GDPR-compliant bare-metal + H100/L40S GPU cloud instances.

name: Oracle for Startups (OCI Cloud & GPU Cluster)
requirements: B2B/B2C product or prototype; open to both bootstrapped and funded companies globally.
tip: Provides a 70% discount on OCI compute/storage for 2 years plus high-density RDMA A100/H100 GPU cluster allocations.

name: IBM Startup Program (IBM Cloud & watsonx)
requirements: Privately held startup <5 years old with a live corporate domain.
tip: Covers bare-metal servers, Red Hat OpenShift, watsonx enterprise AI governance, and IBM Quantum composer access.

name: Vultr Cloud Alliance for Startups
requirements: Company domain, verified billing account, high-growth AI or cloud workload.
tip: Covers 32 global edge locations, NVIDIA HGX H100/B200 clusters, and AMD Instinct MI300X instances with zero long-term lock-in.

name: Scaleway Growth Stage Startup Program
requirements: Early-stage or growth startup building cloud-native or AI products; Early Stage tier starts at €1,800 with zero funding required.
tip: Europe's largest sovereign AI supercomputer host (H100 PCIe/SXM, L40S, Apple Silicon Mac mini M2/M4 CI nodes in Paris/Amsterdam/Warsaw).

name: Anthropic Claude Startup Program (Partner & VC Track)
requirements: Building with Claude API (Sonnet/Haiku/Opus), corporate domain, partner accelerator/VC referral or Menlovc Anthology Fund track.
tip: You can also consume Claude models directly using Google Cloud ($350k Vertex AI Model Garden) or AWS Activate ($100k Amazon Bedrock) credits!

name: OpenAI Startup API Credits (via Microsoft / Partner Accelerators)
requirements: Enrollment in Microsoft Founders Hub or partner accelerator (YC, Techstars, Sequoia, Stripe Atlas).
tip: Microsoft Founders Hub grants immediate $2,500 direct api.openai.com credits in addition to up to $150,000 in Azure OpenAI Service quota.

name: ElevenLabs AI Startup Grants
requirements: Team <25 employees, concrete voice/conversational AI integration plan.
tip: Includes full Enterprise-grade low-latency Conversational AI Agents, voice cloning, and dubbing API for 12 months.

name: Perplexity Enterprise & Sonar API Startup Perks
requirements: Available via Stripe Atlas, Mercury, Brex, or AWS Activate Marketplace Perks.
tip: Powers real-time grounded web search, citations, and Deep Research (`sonar-deep-research`) inside autonomous B2B agents.

name: Fireworks AI & Together AI Startup Inference Credits
requirements: Production LLM routing or fine-tuning workload; apply with corporate email.
tip: Ideal for low-latency DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, and custom LoRA adapter serving with speculative decoding.

name: GitHub for Startups (Enterprise + Actions + Security)
requirements: Early-stage startup (up to Series A) that has not previously been on paid GitHub Enterprise.
tip: Provides 20 seats of GitHub Enterprise (100% off Year 1, 50% off Year 2) + 50,000 GitHub Actions CI/CD minutes/month.

name: MongoDB for Startups (Atlas Vector Search + Voyage AI)
requirements: Software/AI startup <7 years old, Series A or earlier, live website.
tip: Includes MongoDB Atlas credits, Voyage AI embedding token credits, and 1-on-1 schema & vector index consultation.

name: PostHog for Startups (Product Analytics, Replay & LLM Observability)
requirements: Company <2 years old and <$5M raised (bootstrapped companies qualify immediately).
tip: Covers Product Analytics, Session Replay, Feature Flags, A/B Experiments, and LLM trace observability in one platform.

name: Datadog for Startups (Pro Infrastructure & APM)
requirements: New Datadog customer, <$10M funding raised, partner/VC or ecosystem referral.
tip: Full APM, Kubernetes monitoring, Log Management, and LLM Observability free for Year 1.

name: Notion for Startups (Plus Plan + Unlimited Notion AI)
requirements: <100 employees, non-paying Notion workspace, corporate email domain.
tip: Use a partner code (AWS Activate, Microsoft Founders Hub, Stripe Atlas, or GitHub) for 6 months vs 3 months standard.

name: Sentry for Startups (Error & Performance Monitoring)
requirements: Early-stage startup building web, mobile, desktop, or AI agent software.
tip: Combine with GitHub for Startups or YC/Founder Hub perks for 12 months of Business tier crash & trace diagnostics.

name: Supabase, Neon & Pinecone AI Vector DB Startup Credits
requirements: Available via GitHub Student/Startup Pack, Cloudflare for Startups, and AWS Activate Perks.
tip: Covers pgvector, serverless branching Postgres, Auth, and Edge Functions with zero idle database costs.

name: Stripe Fee-Free Payment Processing Credits
requirements: Active Stripe account; claimable inside Microsoft Founders Hub, AWS Activate Perks, or Stripe Atlas.
tip: Waives the 2.9% + $0.30 Stripe processing fee on your first $20,000 to $150,000 in customer checkout volume.

name: B2B Acquisition Ad Grants (Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit & X Ads)
requirements: New advertiser account per platform with verified business billing.
tip: Includes Google Ads ($500–$1,500 match), Microsoft Advertising ($3,000 via Founders Hub), Reddit Ads ($500 for DevTools), and X/LinkedIn B2B coupons.

name: Intercom Early Stage (90% Off Fin AI) & HubSpot for Startups
value_label: 90% Off Year 1 (~$15,000 CRM & AI Support Value)
requirements: <5 employees and <$1M funding for Intercom Early Stage ($65/mo flat); partner referral for HubSpot 90% off.
tip: Intercom Early Stage includes Fin AI support agent responses and product tours at 90% off for Year 1.

name: NLnet Foundation / NGI Zero Commons Fund (Open Source & Privacy AI)
requirements: Open-source software, decentralized protocols, E2EE security, or verifiable local AI infrastructure.
tip: Open to individual engineers and companies worldwide provided the funded module is released under an OSI-approved open-source license.

name: Astana Hub (Silkway Accelerator / AI Movement) & IT Park Tax/Cloud Perks
provider: Astana Hub / Google for Startups Central Eurasia
requirements: Software/AI export-oriented product; remote incorporation available for international founders.
tip: Combines 0% CIT/PIT/VAT on software exports with direct Google for Startups Silkway Accelerator fast-track and regional GPU grants.
